summary: Iter61 — Pros & Cons Wizard (backend + frontend) fully verified. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases PASSED on the live preview backend — duplicate Pro 409, duplicate Con 409 (incl. case-insensitive), Con rename propagates to 'SHOULD NOT - NewConName' factor, Pro rename propagates to new factor name, and sub-factor creation + Step-5 metadata persistence (operator '>=', data_type 'numeric', expected_value '1000', unit 'INR', weight 60, data_source {type:'ai_llm', config:{prompt:'x'}}) all round-trip via GET /api/pros-cons/{id}. Frontend mobile-viewport (390x844): login OK, wizard reachable at /tools/pros-cons-wizard?id=…&module=pros-cons. STEP 1 shows ONLY 'Factor name' input + 'Add Direct Factor' button (no Expected/Unit) — confirmed via DOM text + screenshot. STEP 5 title = 'Step 5 — Review & Refine Expectations'; each factor card has Type toggle (Quantitative/Qualitative), Expected + unit inputs, Operator chips (≥ ≤ > < = ≠), 'Add sub-factor' (testID pc-addsub-{fid}) and 'Set data source (optional)' (testID pc-ds-{fid}). Tapping Add sub-factor twice spawns sub-factor rows and reveals the 'Split evenly' button (testID pc-split-{fid}). Tapping 'Set data source' opens the Auto-Fetch Configuration modal containing Manual entry, Webhook/API, Web Surf, AI / LLM options and a 'Save data source' button (testID pc-ds-save). NOTE: super@test.com credential from review request returned 401 — fell back to admin@test.com (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). NOTE: modal label in code is 'AI / LLM', not 'AI-LLM' as described in the spec (cosmetic).

issues: Factor name TextInput and 'Add Direct Factor' button have no testID — discoverable only via placeholder='e.g., Mileage' and text='Add Direct Factor'. Adding testIDs (pc-step1-factor-name, pc-step1-add-direct) would harden future regression tests.
